LOPS + foot deformity or PAD + foot deformity Once every 3-6 months 3 High LOPS or PAD, and one or more of the following: - history of a foot ulcer - a lower-extremity amputation (minor or major) - end-stage renal disease Once every 1-3 months Note: LOPS = Loss of Protective Sensation; PAD = Peripheral Artery Disease; * Screening frequency is based on expert opinion, since there is no published evidence to support these intervals Figure 2: Areas of the foot at highest risk for ulceration
